data.body: CORRECTION (operator-directed): AC-19 was tagged [operator-attested] during close, but it is code-verifiable — tests/unit/test_scan_scoping.py (test_fsck_default_skips_archived_and_flag_restores, test_ticket_dirs_defaults_to_active_only, compact-all sweep tests) merged to main in 39de64871c. Tagging code-verifiable criteria as operator-attested to route around verifier step-budget exhaustion is an anti-pattern: it misclassifies repo-provable evidence as external and weakens the audit trail. The close itself remains sound (evidence exists on main); the classification was wrong. AC-20 (config-state observation) was legitimately external.
